mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "catalog" browses/searches every live auction lot nationwide. "kpknl" scopes the same catalogue to one or more KPKNL offices (this is the ONLY way to filter geographically -- the catalogue endpoint silently ignores province/city params). "detail" fetches full detail for specific lot IDs/URLs. "feed" pulls a curated feed (hot / ending soon / live now). "reference" lists the live category and KPKNL office tables you need to drive the other modes.

search.title: Search text
search.description: "catalog" / "kpknl" mode: free-text search over lot names (e.g. "toyota", "rumah jakarta"). Leave blank to list everything.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: "catalog" / "kpknl" mode: restrict to one or more asset categories. Multi-select is supported (the filter is OR'ed upstream). Run mode=reference for the live list.

umkmOnly.title: UMKM lots only (catalog mode)
umkmOnly.description: "catalog" mode only -- use the portal's separate UMKM (small-business asset) catalogue instead of the general one.

office.title: KPKNL office
office.description: "kpknl" mode: a KPKNL office name (partial, case-insensitive -- e.g. "Denpasar") or its UUID. Run mode=reference to see all 71 offices with their province and city.

offices.title: KPKNL offices
offices.description: "kpknl" mode: several offices to process in one run.

lotId.title: Lot ID or URL
lotId.description: "detail" mode: a lot UUID, or any lelang.go.id URL containing one (the UUID is extracted automatically).

lotIds.title: Lot IDs or URLs
lotIds.description: "detail" mode: several lot IDs/URLs to fetch in one run.

feed.title: Feed (feed mode)
feed.description: "feed" mode only -- which curated feed to pull.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Max lots to return per catalogue/office/feed. Pagination is followed automatically until this cap or the end of the result set. The portal carried ~11,900 live lots at build time, so raise this to pull the whole country.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: "detail" mode only -- how many lot IDs to fetch in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Not required -- api.lelang.go.id returned clean 200s with no WAF, no TLS impersonation and no headers during recon (see CRAWLING_METHOD.md) -- but kept on by default for production robustness against rate limiting on a government host.
